heading: INT. LIMESTONE CAVE - CORPORATE RETREAT - DAY

units.text: INT. LIMESTONE CAVE - CORPORATE RETREAT - DAY
A cavern lit by battery lanterns.
Stalactites drip.
A banner reads "TEAM BUILDING 2.0."
Folding chairs ring a flip chart.
CRESSIDA VANCE-HOLT, forties, a regional director in a fleece vest, stands at the flip chart with a marker.
WINIFRED OYELARAN, thirties, her deputy, sits in the front row taking notes.
BARTHOLOMEW PRICE, fifties, the facilitator, perches on a stool with a clicker.
Today we trust-fall into the future.
units.name: CRESSIDA

units.text: Cressida, there's a puddle behind you.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: Winifred, that's a metaphor.
units.name: CRESSIDA

units.text: Let's begin with an icebreaker.
units.name: BARTHOLOMEW

units.text: There is ice already. On the ceiling.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: She is correct.
units.name: BARTHOLOMEW

units.text: Bartholomew, I'd like to see her try the fall first.
units.name: CRESSIDA

units.text: Winifred folds her notebook.
She stands, turns her back to Cressida, and spreads her arms.
Cressida steps forward, then back, then forward.
Catch me.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: I will.
units.name: CRESSIDA

units.text: Cressida, are you ready?
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: I'm always ready.
units.name: CRESSIDA

units.text: She lets herself fall.
Cressida lunges.
She misses.
Winifred hits the stone with a grunt.
Bartholomew drops his clicker.
A stalactite drops its water with a plink.
She was supposed to catch her.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: Who?
units.name: BARTHOLOMEW

units.text: She was supposed to catch me.
units.name: WINIFRED

units.text: She meant to.
units.name: CRESSIDA

units.text: Winifred sits up, holding her elbow.
Cressida kneels beside her.
Both of them glare at Bartholomew.
That concludes module one.
units.name: BARTHOLOMEW
